description: This Python module provides utility functions for handling and updating object permissions within a larger software system. It includes functions for attaching permission details to data dictionaries, managing updates to object permissions (including upsert logic), and creating permission records in a database using an async Prisma client. The code is specific to the management of object permission entities, often involving JSON serialization and database operations.

methods.name: Dict attach_object_permission_to_dict( data_dict: Dict, prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Attaches object permission details to the provided dictionary if an object_permission_id exists by fetching from the database.

methods.name: Optional[str] handle_update_object_permission_common( data_json: Dict, existing_object_permission_id: Optional[str], prisma_client: Optional[PrismaClient], )
methods.description: Handles updating or inserting object permission data in the database, merging with existing data as needed.

methods.name: _set_object_permission( data_json: dict, prisma_client: Optional[PrismaClient], )
methods.description: Creates an object permission record in the database and updates the data JSON with the new permission ID.
